ratings_why.fun: Watching Chicks fed on the enemy's biggest units heave them over, and a jarred carry waking huge, is a great board story; the three new ideas cost some reading time.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7: it is the only tribe that plants things on the enemy board and grows from the enemy's size, on a visible mid-fight clock, and the fantasy (cuckoo in the nest, dormice in jars) is in the rules, not the names.

verdict_why: The core reads well, but Ottilie and Little Gernegroß don't say what happens in the cases players will hit every game.

points.text: Grand Horologe Ottilie Gugger: say where her delayed effects go in the Hour order. Do Eggs she lays at the Hour hatch that same Hour, and does a unit Curfew Warden puts to sleep then wake at once or next Hour?
Little Gernegroß: say what happens if his host dies first (is he gone for the fight?), whether he counts as a unit while hidden, and what 'Four times' on the golden multiplies.
Nest-Box Dormouse: say whether the Chick shoves before it is eaten. 'Shoves, then is eaten' reads best and keeps the cuckoo moment.
The clock counts attacks by both sides, which is hard to follow in your head. Show it as a dial with four marks over the board so the Hour is a beat players can see coming.
Reed-Line Journeyman's second sentence is a rule change for all your Eggs; a short name for it (say, 'Early Hatch') would make it easier to spot.

standouts.why: Little Gernegroß is the seed's whole joke in one card: he hides in the biggest enemy, comes back huge and shoves it.
Jar Dormouse reads at a glance and teaches Asleep on turn 1.
Old Unruh, asleep since autumn and still marked present, growing through every Hour, is a clear and funny capstone.

weakest.why: Key-Turner does nothing you can see on its own; 'Wind 2' only reads once you know the clock well.
First-Call Herald is a plain gold card with little cuckoo in it.
Frau Wechselbalg's payoff happens off the board after the fight, so the changeling idea is hard to see in play.

flags.note: Timing of her delayed Start of Combat effects inside the Hour is not set.
Host dying first, unit count while hidden, and the golden's 'Four times' are not defined.
The golden's Hour on every attack with Door Cuckoo makes the fight hard to follow on screen as well as to balance.
